title: Blue Water Haven | KEY.co
description_expanded: Blue Water Haven is a lakeside masterpiece nestled in the prestigious Park District of WaterColor, just off scenic 30A. Freshly remodeled and thoughtfully designed across three levels and a carriage house, this elegant retreat offers space for up to 16 guests with refined comfort in every detail. The home’s serene Western Lake setting creates a peaceful backdrop for your stay, with tranquil water views from expansive porches, sunlit sitting areas, and a private backyard oasis complete with a heated pool, fire pit, and outdoor dining area. A six-seater golf cart and six adult bikes make exploring the community’s pools, nature trails, and dune lakes effortless. Inside, the home flows with light and luxury—from the cozy first-floor den with wet bar to the open-concept living and chef’s kitchen upstairs, complete with high-end appliances and generous seating. Each of the six King bedrooms, including a second-floor primary suite, is appointed with plush bedding and a private bath, while the charming third-floor bunkroom and carriage house offer stylish spaces for kids or extended family. Every moment at Blue Water Haven invites connection and relaxation, whether you're gathered around the fire pit, lounging by the pool, or savoring lake views from a quiet porch swing. This is 30A living at its most elevated.

Features: Outdoor Firepit Pool Outdoor grill Garden
Guests assume all risk for use of pools
